name: Exterior-Face Ray Casting
aliases: Parallel Volume Ray-Casting on Unstructured Grids
definition: A parallel volume rendering technique for unstructured grids where rays are cast only through visible exterior faces of subvolumes, traversing elements until exiting another exterior face.
summary: Exterior-Face Ray Casting is a parallel volume rendering technique for unstructured grids that restricts ray casting to visible exterior faces, distinguishing itself by separating view-independent connectivity preprocessing from view-dependent face visibility culling.
